title: Multi-domain leads standup log — 2028-06-12
content:
Date: 2028-06-12
Chair: Aisha Patel
Duration: 60m (09:00–10:00 PT)
Location: Zoom + #platform-leads
Attendees: Aisha (platform), Diego (serving-runtime), Maya (observability), Ethan (private-deployments), Priya (sre), Lina (product-hosted-api - joined 09:25), plus notes from Sam (release-eng)
Absentees: None noted

Purpose: Weekly cross-domain leadership pulse to align priorities, surface operational risks, make quick decisions for rollout windows, and capture cross-team blockers. Notes are intentionally concise — action owners + due dates at the bottom.

Agenda (pre-circulated):
- Platform health & capacity (Aisha)
- Latency/cost anomaly recap (Maya/Diego)
- Dedicated capacity onboarding checklist (Ethan)
- Private deployment pilot status (Ethan/Priya)
- Rollout gating for model-x2 canary (Diego)
- Observability gaps & short-term instrumentation (Maya)
- Release windows / freeze proposals (Sam)
- Quick wins & parking lot

Top-line summary:
- Platform capacity OK for typical traffic; we observed a mid-week latency spike during the internal load test correlating to an autoscaler regression (see INF-4321). Temporary mitigations applied; root cause under investigation.
- Decision: postpone model-x2 production canary by 72h to validate fallback paths and KV cache metrics.
- Private pilot: first five customers on VPC path — onboarding checklist mostly complete, need final KMS integration testing.

Notes by topic:
1) Platform health & capacity (Aisha)
- Weekly metrics: 95th p95 token latency for hosted baseline = 78ms (goal 70ms), token cost slightly above forecast due to increased q8 inference usage.
- Observed more short-lived autoscaler churn on node pools c-3 and c-4 during load test. Hypothesis: aggressive scale down policy combined with pod eviction timing.
- Immediate ask: platform-engineering to relax scale-down aggressiveness on c-3 and c-4 for next 48h while we gather traces. Owner: Aisha. Due: 2028-06-14.
- Note: finance flagged a ~6% spend variance tied to burst reservations; finance will follow up (linked PLAT-987).

2) Latency/cost anomaly recap (Maya + Diego)
- Incident summary: mid-week load test triggered repeated cold-starts in the serving runtime; spikes aligned with node reclaims (INC-2028-06-10).
- Root cause: two contributors: (a) kernel bump on a minority of nodes led to slower init of GPU drivers, (b) a change in our continuous batching heuristic that increased batch window for short-seq workloads.
- Short-term mitigations deployed: pin kernel version on affected pools, rollback batching heuristic to previous stable.
- Long-term: add pre-warmed pool for short-sequence workloads; estimate 3 sprints to prototype. Owner: Diego. Due: prototype by 2028-08-02.
- Action: Observability to add per-pod driver-init timing and per-request batching delay markers. Owner: Maya. Due: 2028-06-19.

3) Dedicated capacity onboarding (Ethan)
- Contracts signed with two mid-market customers; we need dedicated GPU pools provisioned in us-west2 and eu-central1.
- Remaining tasks: quota ticket to cloud provider (PLAT-2011), network ACL verification, billing setup, and handshake with CS for onboarding runbook.
- Risk: cloud quota ticket predicted 5–10 day lead time — block for go-live if not expedited. Ask: Exec to approve expedited quota request (Aisha to escalate).

4) Private deployment pilot (Ethan + Priya)
- Pilot status: three customers in VPC pilot, two in early on-prem staging.
- KMS/HSM: integration with customer-managed KMS failing 1 of 6 flows (wrap/unwrap timing out). Suspect misconfiguration in STS role assumption.
- Action: Priya to run an end-to-end test with sample key material and provide a checklist. Owner: Priya. Due: 2028-06-16.
- Security note: audit logging for private control plane needs retention config; security team to propose defaults. Follow-up with security-and-compliance space.

5) Model rollouts and gating (Diego + Lina)
- model-x2 canary: initial internal runs show small regression on commonsense QA (drop ~1.2% on our internal eval). Also higher latency on long-context sequences.
- Decision (voted, unanimous): delay public canary by 72 hours; expand canary set to include two additional internal traffic shapes and the fallback route to model-x1 must be exercised at least 5 times/hour during canary. Owner: Diego + Lina. Due: decision effective immediately; re-eval 2028-06-15.
- Note: shipping team to add a circuit-breaker metric that trips if p95 latency > 200ms for 5m. Owner: Diego. Due: 2028-06-15.

6) Observability & short-term instrumentation (Maya)
- Gaps surfaced: KV cache hit rate not visible at token-granularity for multi-tenant workloads; current metric insufficient to validate cache effectiveness per-customer.
- Proposed quick wins: add tenant-tagged KV hit/miss counters (low overhead), add synthetic traffic that simulates 3 common prefix patterns.
- Action: Maya to scope implementation and run synthetic test. Owner: Maya. Due: 2028-06-21.

7) Release windows / freeze proposals (Sam)
- Upcoming externally visible release for hosting console + API changes targeted for 2028-07-02. Proposal: code freeze for runtime changes starting 2028-06-26 to reduce risk during canaries.
- Feedback: team leads prefer soft freeze (no risky infra changes) but allow hotfix patches. Final call by 2028-06-20. Owner: Sam.

Parking lot / quick wins
- Investigate a small on-request token-compression trick for embeddings to cut spend for batched embed pipelines (R&D spike). Owner: eng-optimize. Due: 2028-06-30.
- Draft a one-pager on Dedicated onboarding timeline for CS to send to customers. Owner: Ethan. Due: 2028-06-15.

Open questions / risks
- Can we get expedited cloud quota? (Aisha to escalate)
- Are we comfortable with current rollback automation coverage for private air-gapped installs? (Priya to confirm scope)
- How large is the variance in cost forecasting from q8 quantization adoption? (Finance to model; linked PLAT-987)

Decisions made this session
- Postpone model-x2 public canary by 72h; require expanded traffic shapes and fallback exercises.
- Relax scale-down aggressiveness on specific node pools for 48h while traces collected.
- Apply kernel pin on affected node pools as mitigation for cold-start driver issues.

Action items (owner — due)
- Aisha: escalate cloud quota (PLAT-2011) and confirm target timeline — due 2028-06-14.
- Diego: prototype pre-warmed short-seq pool — prototype by 2028-08-02; implement circuit-breaker metric for model-x2 canary — due 2028-06-15.
- Maya: add per-pod driver-init timing and batching delay markers; add tenant-tagged KV cache counters; run synthetic prefix tests — initial infra by 2028-06-19, synthetic test by 2028-06-21.
- Priya: KMS end-to-end test with sample key material + checklist for private pilot — due 2028-06-16; confirm rollback automation scope for on-prem — due 2028-06-18.
- Ethan: finalize Dedicated onboarding one-pager for CS; follow up with billing and quota ticket; work with Aisha on escalation — one-pager due 2028-06-15.
- Sam: finalize release freeze policy recommendation and circulate — due 2028-06-20.

Misc notes / notes-to-self (informal)
- Aisha: follow-up with finance on the cost variance and get a short note for leadership.
- Diego: collect a few failing trace samples and upload to GH gist for triage.
- Maya: remember to correlate batch-window metric with sequence-length histogram — early signal.

Next meeting: 2028-06-19, 09:00 PT
Please flag if any action item assignments look off or if owners need additional context. If you're listed and cannot meet a due date, mark on the doc and ping on Slack.

End of notes.
